name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is the largest release since v0.4.0, spanning 238 commits. Highlights include 'Connect Knowledge' for read-only cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox), a greatly expanded 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and per-room agent Channels with a Telegram remote-control gateway. The release also introduces clean-path routing (replacing hash routing), a 'Manila Arc' UI redesign, improved editor capabilities (Mermaid, LaTeX), and significant auth hardening with PBKDF2 password hashing and login rate-limiting. See the full release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and active contributions
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate for daemon auth

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a full-featured document management system with workflows and permissions, but its broader scope makes it heavier than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and classification but requires more infrastructure setup compared to Cabinet's simpler deployment.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a much broader productivity platform with file management included, but its large footprint far exceeds Cabinet's lightweight philosophy.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focuses on file browsing across multiple backends, but lacks dedicated document management and organization features found in Cabinet.
